title: Command Walking
caption: Fresh training, selected at 8,000 simulation steps (32,000 gradient updates) after 611 seconds of training on a local L40S, excluding dependency installation and evaluation. All 10 commands × 5 perturbed starts × 15 seconds passed the declared gate with zero falls. Forward mean maximum cross-track deviation: 0.169 m. These are five starting states, not five independent training seeds. Actual Colab remains untested.

title: Desert Droid Run
caption: 45.72 simulation seconds, zero falls, all three obstacles and the rough patch crossed before the raised finish. Classroom obstacles: 17.5–20 mm; ascent: 18 cm. Uses the fresh walking policy and the varied-start hopping curriculum. Visually directed speed/yaw/mode commands with pauses; not autonomous navigation or a real-time human play test. An earlier attempt missed an obstacle and was retained as incomplete.

title: Moving Hops
caption: Small moving hops on 15 mm practice terrain after stationary, moving, and varied-start terrain training. Five slow-command trials: zero falls, mean peak simultaneous sole clearance 3.0 cm, and 9.6 landed hops per 15 seconds. Body rise is a different measurement. This 2,000-step terrain checkpoint passed flat/on-step handovers and completed the recorded course. Later training regressed; more steps are not automatically better. A repeated evaluation of these same weights later missed a forward hop-count requirement; that failure is preserved with the experiment.
